lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged horizontally across the mid-flank; a primary row of larger blobs is positioned medially, with a second row of smaller, higher-density spots located near the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create a grid-like configuration on the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and distinct shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance spots localized on the leading edge and proximal dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
